input: Take a cold water swimming class outdoors

gold.taskTitle: Take an Outdoor Cold Water Swimming Class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and attend an outdoor cold water swimming class.

questions.title: Have you ever swum in cold open water before?
questions.description: Understanding the user's prior experience with cold water swimming to gauge skill and comfort level.

questions.title: What is your current location or preferred search area?
questions.description: Identifying the geographic area where the user wants to find a class.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe to start?
questions.description: Understanding when the user wants to begin or complete the class.

questions.title: What type of outdoor venue do you prefer for this?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the user prefers a lake, river, sea, lido, or reservoir setting.

questions.title: Are you aiming for a one-off session or a full course?
questions.description: Determining whether the user wants a single introductory lesson or a multi-week structured course.

questions.title: Do you have any medical conditions relevant to cold water exposure?
questions.description: Identifying health factors such as heart conditions, Raynaud's, or asthma that could affect participation.

questions.title: What is your budget range for booking this class?
questions.description: Understanding the financial constraints to help narrow down suitable class options.
